newsitem.title: MONGOLIA: MONGOLIA'S BROAD M2 UP 29.14 PCT YR/YR AT END-JUNE.
newsitem.headline: MONGOLIA'S BROAD M2 UP 29.14 PCT YR/YR AT END-JUNE.

text.p: Mongolia's broad M2 money supply rose a year-on-year 29.14 percent at the end of June to 137.8581 billion tugriks, up from 106.7455 billion a year ago, the State Statistical Bulletin said on Tuesday.
Broad M2 grew by 3.58 percent in June alone from 133.0935 billion tugriks at in the end of May, the bulletin said.
It said M1, or cash in circulation plus deposits, was up a year-on-year 35.9 percent at the end of June to 67.6438 billion tugriks, compared with 49.7656 billion at end-June 1996.
M1 rose 4.88 percent in June alone from 64.4926 billion tugriks at the end of May, it said.
Cash in circulation, or M0, rose 50.18 percent year-on-year at the end of June to 52.7752 billion tugriks, compared with 35,139.7 billion tugriks a year ago, it said.
M0 rose 8.08 percent in June alone from 48.8312 billion tugriks at the end of May, it said.
